body:
A low-line calibrated spectral match does not test higher measured transitions. This adds a reproducible four-coordinate calibration of the supplied single-cosine transmon plus full resonator model, followed by three unused KIT measurements. Their drive-frequency residuals are **+5.181438, +14.395723 and +28.257343 MHz**. No higher transition enters the fit.

The note also proves the conditional square-sector operator identity EC=K, EJ=4 delta. Physical circuit identification, parameters, offset mean, spectroscopy and cross-cooldown cavity calibration remain imported. This retrospective comparison is not a native TOE prediction, statistical rejection, unique diagnosis of Josephson harmonics, or global no-go. The published discrepancy direction was already known.

- [Source note](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/docs/TRANSMON_CALIBRATION_HOLDOUT_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-26.md)
- [Runner](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/scripts/transmon_calibration_holdout_2026_09_26.py) and [fresh canonical cache](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/logs/runner-cache/transmon_calibration_holdout_2026_09_26.txt)

- [Conformance/review history](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/.claude/science/physics-loops/transmon-holdout-20260926/REVIEW_HISTORY.md), [independent final source review](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/.claude/science/physics-loops/transmon-holdout-20260926/FINAL_PUBLICATION_REVIEW.md), [source review](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/.claude/science/physics-loops/transmon-holdout-20260926/SOURCE_REVIEW.md)

Validation: fresh primary execution; separately constructed direct charge-photon operator; larger numerical bases; three calibration starts; unique spectral labels and sampled coupling checks; charge grid; all sixteen declared calibration-corner refits. Nominal evaluated transitions agree across constructions within 30 Hz. Finite corner scenarios are not a confidence region or continuum enclosure. Source review corrected total-versus-drive units and exposed transferred cooldown calibration. No material final-source defect remained.

Seven scratch mutations were detected: changed CSV byte, underfit optimizer, inconsistent saved root, halved coupling matrix, inadequate basis, collapsed state assignment and omitted available evaluation line. [Mutation receipt and portable harness](https://github.com/jonathonreilly/qubit-lattice-axiom-framework/blob/physics-loop/transmon-holdout-20260926/.claude/science/physics-loops/transmon-holdout-20260926/MUTATIONS.txt). Scoped vocabulary checks, Python compilation and committed-delta whitespace checks passed. Graph delta is exactly one new note and two intended parent edges; manifest acknowledgment is included. No generated audit authority changes.

Reproduce: `python3 scripts/transmon_calibration_holdout_2026_09_26.py`; guard faults: `python3 .claude/science/physics-loops/transmon-holdout-20260926/mutation_checks.py`.

Status: **bounded_theorem / conditional-support**, unaudited; frontier-discovery trace partially addresses the user goal of testing real measurements. No physical import is retired. Full pipeline, strict audit lint and changed-evidence validation remain required on the exact integrated current-main landing candidate under conformance section 12. This author PR does not merge or ratify science.

Next science obligation: independently derive device/microscopic corrections and an error budget before using additional measurements. Alternate roots, drive shifts, extra modes and cross-cooldown systematics remain open. Base revision: e37967e326c2bdb429bd3106d34158bd5420e9c0.
